1. 베드로전서 기록배경\n - 베드로가 직접 기록한 것이 아니고 실루아:
1. Background of the writing of 1 Peter
 - Peter didn't write it himself; it says it was written by Silvanus. You can also see that Mark went along with him as an attendant.
2. 베드로가 말하는 참 소망\n - 베드로는 기독교의 박해가 점점 다가:
2. The true hope Peter speaks of
 - Peter felt that persecution of Christianity was drawing closer and closer, and he wrote this letter with the thought that only a firm hope can overcome persecution.
<롬8:18> 생각건대 현재의 고난은 장차 우리에게 나타날 영광과 족히: <Rom 8:18> For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
아무것도 없는데 고난을 참을 이유가 없죠. 죽음 너머에 뭔가 있다는 소망:
If there's nothing there, there's no reason to endure suffering. You can bear the pain of this life only if you have a hope that there's something beyond death. So hope too, in the end, is strong faith.
 1) A true hope based on God's promise
 - The hope Peter talks about isn't some vague wish; it's a true hope based on God's promise. One that is guaranteed to come true. A trustworthy hope that God himself guarantees.
 2) A hope incorruptible, undefiled, and that fadeth not away
 - Everything in this world is going to rot.
 - If you live putting your hope in things like that, when they rot, you'll rot too.
 3) A hope as firm as an anchor of the soul
 - If you have a hope like that, it's like an anchor of the soul and you won't be shaken.
<히6:19> 우리가 이 소망이 있는 것은 영혼의 닻 같아서 튼튼하고 견:
<Heb 6:19> Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil
 4) A hope that goes on beyond death
 - People who don't know Christianity think death is the end, but death is not the end; it's the beginning. The beginning of eternal life. So we live dreaming of the life beyond that death. Through death we'll be cut off from this world. So let's not love the things of this world too much.
 5) A hope that lets us overcome and endure tribulation and persecution
 - Without certainty about the life to come, you can't be martyred. The faith we need to have now is a faith ready for martyrdom. The preparations for persecution are already finished.
 6) A hope that makes us holy
 - Every person who has this hope must purify himself. Because the world we're going to enter is a holy world.
 7) A hope you can explain to people
 - I haven't yet met anyone who asked me the reason for my hope. Probably because I didn't look like someone who has hope, right? But you have to be well prepared. Because you don't know when someone will ask.
그런데 베드로가 단순히 누가 물을지도 모르니까, 속된 말로 쪽팔리지 않으: But Peter wasn't simply saying, someone might ask, so to put it crudely, get yourself a bit prepared so you won't be embarrassed; he's saying don't just have hope, know clearly even the reason for it, in other words, have true knowledge.
